items.title: Arsenal fear Saka could be out for two months

items.title: Many feared trapped under collapsed building in Nairobi
items.excerpt: People are feared to be trapped after a large, unfinished building in Nairobi collapsed during construction. Rescue operations have proven complicated as police fired tear gas to disperse looters.
